item.title: 'Skull Horde' Gets April Release Date - Trailer
item.description: Skull Horde is an auto battler dungeon crawler where you play as a flying skull necromancer, find powerful loot and create overpowered build as you summon a horde of skeletons in a battle of bone versus flesh!

item.title: 'Lawn Mowing Simulator 2' Launches Kickstarter Campaign, Stretch Goals Include Switch 2 Release & Bonus In-Game Content - Trailer
item.description: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 is heading to the U.S.A. to start a whole new career in the world of lawncare!

item.title: 'Wartales' To Get Contract: Fires in the Capital DLC in April, Adds New Location And Scenarios - Screens & Trailer
item.description: Wartales is an open-world RPG where players lead a group of mercenaries in search of wealth across a massive medieval universe. Explore the world, recruit companions, collect bounties and unravel the secrets of the tombs of the ancients!

item.title: 'Guilty Gear -Strive-' Season 5 Begins In April Adding Jam Kuradoberi, Coincides With v2.00 Update - Trailer
item.description: Guilty Gear -Strive- is the latest entry in the fighting game franchise, and upholds the series' reputation for groundbreaking hybrid 2D/3D cell-shaded graphics and intense, rewarding gameplay.

item.title: 'Golden Tides' Is A Pirate-Themed MOBA For PC, Accepting Sign-Ups For Q2 Playtest, Secures $3.5M Funding - Trailer
item.description: Golden Tides is a pirate-themed 4v4 Adventure MOBA that breaks the genre wide open.

item.title: 'Hello Kitty Island Adventure' To Get City Town DLC In April, Adds New City, Shops And More - Trailer
item.description: Hello Kitty Island Adventure is a cozy life sim where you explore a massive world with over 100 hours of adventure alongside Hello Kitty and her friends.

item.title: 'Fortnite' Downturn Forces Epic Games To Lay Off 1000 Employees, Titles Shutting Down, Looking To Cut $500 Million In Costs
item.description: Epic Games revealed that due to a downturn in Fortnite player engagement it is laying off 1000 employees and looking for an additional $500 million in cost reduction.

item.title: 'MOUSE: P.I. For Hire' Reveals Physical/Digital Editions, Pre-Order, Xbox Play Anywhere Support, But PS4, Xbox One And Nintendo Switch Delayed
item.description: Mouse: P.I. For Hire is a gritty and noir-fueled FPS shooter that draws inspiration from classic cartoons of the 1930s.

item.title: 'Albion Online' Comes To Xbox Series X|S In April - Trailer
item.description: Albion Online is a free-to-play medieval style sandbox MMO, offering players an extensive character customization system with no class restrictions, a completely player-driven economy and dynamic PvP battles.

item.title: 'World Of Warcraft' Hits The Road With '20 Years of Music' Concert Tour
item.description: The duality of World of Warcraft’s epic second chapter of the Worldsoul Saga, Midnight, explores this very question as the looming conflict between the forces of Light and the Void threatens to devour Azeroth.
